strings.name: Christiana Figueres
strings.summary: Figueres moved from development cooperation and energy policy into climate diplomacy, leading the UNFCCC secretariat from 2010 to 2016. After the Copenhagen setback she helped rebuild multilateral trust and worked with states and non-state actors toward the 2015 Paris Agreement. She later co-founded Global Optimism and continues climate advocacy through books, podcasts and business cooperation.

strings.highlights.h2.title: Public climate communication
strings.highlights.h2.text: Co-founded Global Optimism and uses podcasts and books to advance societal and corporate climate action.

strings.timeline.t5.title: Helped achieve Paris Agreement

strings.timeline.t6.title: Led UNFCCC secretariat
strings.timeline.t6.text: Became executive secretary after Copenhagen, working to restore negotiating trust.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Founded development centre
